name: Audit preparation
summary: Before the external auditors arrive, your controller holds one audit pack: every request with its owner, date, document and status, the control evidence they will test, last year's findings and what was done, and draft answers to the questions they will ask. People approve everything before it goes.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's brief and rules for this workflow template: the control evidence checks (controls and the evidence each leaves, who approves, records, handles the money and checks, and payments at or above the approval limit), stated column headers with a stop on a mismatch, draft answers only from supplied facts, sensitive questions left for a named person and advisers, and approval by a person before anything goes to the auditors.

sources.contribution: The request list turned into a tracker with owners, statuses and internal dates ahead of the auditors' dates; the format each document is wanted in; comparison with last year's list; explanations for movements over a threshold; each expected question sent to whoever holds the answer; a second person's review before hand-over; last year's findings set beside what was done.
